decisions.reason: Because this waterproof lined safety shoe range is close to the firm's core footwear know-how and the firm has its own R&D, management can learn from market feedback and refine it, so despite some portfolio-pruning risk it is more likely to be retained.

An electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe fits very closely with the firm's established protective-footwear capabilities and customer base, and with in-house R&D the firm is well placed to improve and keep such a product.

A safety shoe series lies at the center of the firm's existing product knowledge and broad offer, so under high absorptive capacity management would usually continue it unless specific sales results turned out weak.
